subtasks: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
Place the adjustable wrench from the table into its matching wrench-shaped recess in the toolbox.
Straighten the adjustable wrench lying diagonally in the toolbox and seat it lengthwise in the recess next to the hammer.
Place the yellow tape measure in the matching rear-right pocket of the toolbox using the right gripper.
Place the pliers from the right side of the table flat into their forked recess in the toolbox, then open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
Regrasp the pliers resting on the toolbox front rim and seat them flat in the forked recess in front of the tape measure. Open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
Withdraw the open right gripper upward to clear the toolbox. Leave all four tools in their seats and return both arms to their initial poses with both grippers fully open.

Use the left gripper to reseat the adjustable wrench in the center channel. Its jaw rests on the rear lip. Lift it slightly and shift it toward the front of the toolbox so it lies flat in the recess, then release and return home open.
